name: Drawer
description: Shows edge sheets for navigation or inspection, with focus management and swipe dismissal.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the open state changes

onOpenChangeComplete.description: Called after the open or close transition finishes

modal.description: true draws the scrim and blocks the page; trap-focus keeps focus inside without a scrim; false leaves the page usable

snapPoints.description: Snap points for a bottom sheet: viewport fractions, pixels, or px/rem strings

disablePointerDismissal.description: Keep the drawer open on an outside press

when: Editing or creating alongside the page behind it
Navigation that slides in and back out
Detail views that overlay rather than replace
whenNot: Navigation that stays on screen (use Sidebar)
A short list of actions (use Menu or Popover)
Feedback the user does not act on (use Toast)
guidelines: end for editing and inspecting, start for navigation, bottom for touch
start and end follow the writing direction; the swipe that dismisses follows the side
Always give a visible way out: Drawer.Close in the header or footer
Pass render={<Button />} to Drawer.Trigger or Drawer.Close to use a library control
Use modal="trap-focus" for an inspector that should not dim the page
accessibility: Returns focus to the trigger on close
A body that overflows joins the tab order so it scrolls from the keyboard

propsSummary: modal: true|trap-focus|false - scrim and page blocking (default: true)
disablePointerDismissal: boolean - keep open on an outside press
Drawer.Content side: start|end|bottom - the edge, start/end follow the writing direction (default: end)
Drawer.Content size: sm|md|lg - width on start/end, height on bottom (default: md)
Drawer.Content initialFocus: boolean|ref|function - focus target on open (default: true)
Drawer.Content finalFocus: boolean|ref|function - focus target on close (default: true)
Drawer.Trigger, Drawer.Close render: element - render a library control
